Original unknown values acquire concrete checked property/call/constructor views. The views retain identity; numeric and string boundaries keep original primitive-conversion order. The browser process Item constructor becomes a native class with declared fields and the original assignments and prototype run method. Its own constructor .prototype metadata is nonwritable, as required by native class syntax; the original function had writable .prototype metadata. The workload never rewrites that constructor property.

Their original prototype assignment/new/reset or prototype assignment/new protocol needs a writable function .prototype. A checked construct view returns the same original allocator.
